admin_email.description: Email address of the list administrator (for bug reports and list management requests).

list_name.description: Name of the mailing list (used in list ID and subject prefixes).

domain.description: Domain used for list addresses (e.g., discuss@example.com).

list_dir.description: Absolute path to the list's working directory (contains queues, archives, and metadata).

access_type.description: Access mode for the list: 'public', 'private', or 'moderated'. Controls visibility and posting permissions.

moderate.description: If true, all posts require moderator approval before delivery.

subscribe_enabled.description: If true, allow users to subscribe to the list via email command.

unsubscribe_enabled.description: If true, allow users to unsubscribe from the list via email command.

require_subscription_confirm.description: If true, require subscription confirmation via email (prevents accidental or spam subscriptions).

allow_anonymous_post.description: If true, permit posts from unauthenticated or non-subscriber senders.

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for incoming messages (0 = unlimited).

max_attachment_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed per attachment (0 = no limit per file).

max_attachments.description: Maximum number of attachments allowed per message.

retry_interval.description: Seconds between delivery retries for failed messages.

max_retry.description: Maximum number of delivery retries before bouncing a message.

archive_enabled.description: If true, archive all list messages to disk.

archive_dir.description: Directory where archived messages are stored.

digest_enabled.description: If true, enable digest mode (batching messages into periodic digests).

digest_max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of a digest before sending (e.g., 86400 = 1 day).

digest_max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to include in a single digest before sending early.

welcome_msg_enabled.description: If true, send a welcome message to new subscribers.

goodbye_msg_enabled.description: If true, send a goodbye message when a user unsubscribes.

moderators.description: List of email addresses for list moderators (they may approve/deny posts in moderated mode).

additional_admins.description: List of additional email addresses granted administrative rights (in addition to admin_email).
